1.0.label: Per-asset future value and yearly market-value breakdown
1.0.notes: Baseline before effective return percentages were added to yearly projections. Use this commit as the rollback reference for Version 1.0.

1.1.label: Monthly-contribution effective return percentages
1.1.notes: Adds effective cumulative return percentages against contributed capital for total portfolio and each asset, while retaining monthly contribution compounding.

1.2.label: Equity Sleeve stock-style allocation
1.2.notes: Adds stock-style selection inside the system-defined equity allocation while keeping total portfolio equity exposure unchanged.

1.3.label: Three starting-capital planning modes
1.3.notes: Adds Goal, Lump Sum, and Investor-Trader Cash Buffer starting modes.

1.4.label: Separate mode-specific Wealth questionnaires
1.4.notes: Each planning mode receives its own questionnaire and still maps into the same suitability guardrails.

1.5.label: Customer-facing Wealth language
1.5.notes: Rewrites the Wealth journey for client-facing use.

1.6.label: Separated Wealth planners with dedicated Cash Buffer logic
1.6.notes: Cash Buffer receives dedicated RDPU/RDPT logic and active capital remains separate.

1.7.label: Single-page mode selection without repeated navigation
1.7.notes: Users choose a mode once and continue on the same page.

1.8.label: Landing-only mode selection with dedicated selected-mode tabs
1.8.notes: The main Wealth page stops at Step 1. Clicking a mode opens a dedicated planner tab with the selected mode already active.

1.9.label: Professional brokerage-oriented Wealth experience
1.9.notes: Refreshes customer-facing language and visual hierarchy, adds richer mode cards and a smooth new-tab loading state, and updates all three questionnaires around investment objective, time horizon, liquidity, financial capacity, concentration, market experience, and risk tolerance. Investor/Trader mode additionally asks about cash-flow dependence, loss limits, and brokerage/leverage knowledge without automatically recommending leverage products.
